ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity pixels (white/light-grey lobes) to 35% low-intensity pixels (central dark region and peduncle).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity V-shaped region extending from the peduncle to the median notch. Flanking high-intensity lobes with secondary low-intensity mottling. Discrete dark circular focal spot at the left distal edge. Multiple small dark foci clustered along the right trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 75 degrees; apex depth constitutes approximately 15% of the fluke's vertical height from peduncle to lobe peak.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the continuous trailing edge. Pixel-amplitude variations of approximately 5-15 pixels. Pronounced jagged peaks are visible on the inner margins of both lobes near the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward sweep originating from the median notch and extending towards the distal tips, with a slight distal taper.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density cluster of high-intensity micro-foci (white speckling) on the low-intensity peduncle. Discrete dark circular pixel cluster located on the distal section of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single dark linear disruption oriented near-perpendicular to the leading edge on the distal left lobe. Faint vertical linear marks on the mid-left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular serration patterns on the trailing edge suggesting previous physical trauma; discrete dark focal mark on the left lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense white-on-black speckling pattern isolated specifically to the peduncle region.
